question: Compare what the Matrice 30T and Matrice 4T manuals say happens if the pilot cancels low battery RTH.
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.reason: Compare manuals on what happens when pilot cancels low-battery RTH for Matrice 30T and Matrice 4T.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: reestablish the control link after loss; if unsuccessful, start emergency/contingency procedures; if VLOS cannot be regained, follow loss-of-VLOS procedures; risk descriptions should describe hazards. Matrice 30T manuals: when battery is too low to return home, land as soon as possible; a low-battery warning appears in DJI Pilot 2 when there is just enough power to complete an RTH. There is no usable evidence for Matrice 4T or Matrice 30T incident reports. Explicit description of what happens when the pilot cancels low-battery RTH in either Matrice 30T or Matrice 4T manuals is missing.
